jobs.description: Description de l'entrepriseSGS, the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company, is currently seeking an Immunoanalysis Team Leader for its SAINT-BENOÎT (86) site (POITIERS, 1h15 from Paris Montparnasse by TGV).SGS employs 99,500 professionals across 115 countries, with a network of more than 2,500 laboratories and offices.With over 145 years of excellence in serving our clients, we combine the precision and accuracy that characterize Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards in quality, compliance and sustainability.Our brand promise, "when you need to be sure", reflects our commitment to reliability and integrity, enabling businesses to grow with confidence. We are proud to deliver our expert services under the SGS name and trusted specialized brands such as Brightsight, Bluesign, Maine Pointe and Nutrasource.Our SAINT-BENOÎT site, specialized in new drug development, conducts pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, immunogenicity and biomarker testing. The laboratory consists of 25 Study Directors and 35 Technicians.Description du posteSGS France, based in SAINT-BENOÎT - POITIERS (86), is looking for an Immunoanalysis Team Leader with a minimum of 5 years of experience.The successful candidate will be responsible for a team of 8 Study Directors and around a dozen Technicians, providing supervision, management and skills development.We are looking for an Immunoanalysis Team Leader specialized in regulatory bioanalysis (biomarkers). The Immunoanalysis Team Leader will work within a renowned CRO (Contract Research Organization) working in clinical development. Customer-oriented, the SAINT-BENOÎT site supports major pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners worldwide.YOUR MISSION:As the Immunoanalysis Team Leader of our laboratory, you will be responsible for:Leading, mentoring, and developing a team of 8 Study Directors and about a dozen Technicians.Supervising complex bioanalytical studies focused on biomarkers assays.Driving optimization, troubleshooting anomalies, and organizing assays to guarantee optimal data quality.Managing relationships with international clients, ensuring compliance with deadlines and strategic alignment.Adhering to the strictest GCP/GLP standards, FDA directives, and ICH M10 guidelines.Achieving the laboratory revenue targets.You will be the primary subject matter expert for these LBA assays. QualificationsREQUIRED EXPERTISE5 years of experience in regulatory bioanalysis (CRO or pharmaceutical industry), including immunogenicity testing and large molecule analysisProficiency in MSD, Gyrolab and ELISA platforms5 years of management experienceEducation :PhD in biochemistry or a related field (biology, immunology, etc.)Languages :Fluency in French and a strong command of English are mandatory (scientific and general). All communications are conducted in English  Informations supplémentairesWHY JOIN US ?Specific training will be provided upon onboardingThe laboratory was renovated in 2020 and a new one opened in 2026The site is located near POITIERS (a dynamic and historic city) and 1h50 from LA ROCHELLEThis position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, friendly and collaborative scientific environment.

jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. Your working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.     Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges:We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.  We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :  one based in Mobile (USA)  one based in Bangalore (India) The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.  Your main tasks and responsibilities are: Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).   Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.   Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).  This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.  Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. Your boarding pass:You have an advanced level in English.  You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. You have structure and systems skills.  You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.  You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.  You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.  Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.  Take your career to a new level and apply online now! -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Ingénieur en certification et navigabilité   (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Service de certification des réparations basé à Toulouse, France . Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui approuve les solutions de réparations proposées par le bureau d'études du Service Client, suite à un événement en service . Au sein de l'équipe certification et navigabilité, vous aurez la responsabilité de vérifier et attester que la solution technique ainsi appliquée restaure la navigabilité de l'avion. Cette étape est indispensable pour la remise en service de l'avion. Votre environnement de travail :Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d'in

Give your career a new dimensionCore mission:The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. The ILL operates the brightest neutron source in the world and hosts over 2000 visits by scientists per year, who come to carry out world-class research.Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.Your tasks:In this context, you will:- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.- Coordinate the work of ILL services involved in these activities.- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.Your profile:- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more information, please visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditionSounds interesting?Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 22.11.2026, quoting reference number 26/50.Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness for work under ionising radiation is required.We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is based in Grenoble (France) and operates Europe's leadingresearch facility for basic research with neutrons. United by our passion for progress andtechnology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the wayfor discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.www.ill.eu/careers

Core mission:The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.The ILL's Services for Advanced Neutron Environments (SANE) is responsible for the development, maintenance and user support of neutron instruments. In order to maintain our leadership position and ensure a high standard of service, we wish to modernise and improve the sample environment controllers used on the neutron beams.Your tasks:You will join the team of the Services for Advanced Neutron Environments and will contribute to the development and commissioning of new controllers:- PLC and HMI programming and commissioning of:* power supply panels for 1100°C and 1600°C furnaces* 2000-bar helium pressure generators* cryostat test benches- Investigation of the application of machine learning to control systems and predictive maintenance.Your profile:- You hold a Level 7 qualification (Master's degree or equivalent) in Automation Engineering, with several years' experience using human-machine interface (EXOR) and PLC (Schneider) development tools.- You are passionate about systems automation, are keen to work in a multicultural environment, and enjoy tackling technical challenges.- You are a strong team player and have good analytical skills.- You are keen to be involved in every stage of a project, from the design phase through to commissioning.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. For more information, please visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.Sounds interesting?Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/49.Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. Give your career a new dimensionCore mission:The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.Your tasks:Your main responsibilities will be the following:- Provide routine and emergency care- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards- Carry out workstation assessments- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentationYour profile:- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.Sounds interesting?Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day.
